dissent: The gate's clean-cgroup check has no admitted Windows-side equivalent; the proposal marks it UNRESOLVED rather than inventing a mechanism, which leaves a genuine coverage asymmetry between hosts.

Hash-stable re-verification in the rerun rules permits skipping re-execution of unchanged checks after non-candidate repairs; a stricter reading of the historical workflow could demand full re-execution on any repair.

Two owned audits and two bound reviews are the stated requirement, but reviewer identity for construction-final reviews is left to the manifest; if reviewers end up non-independent the gate still structurally passes its binding checks.
